# RaidGuild

> RaidGuild is a builder-owned community of designers, engineers, researchers, strategists, and operators exploring emerging technology together. Its members share knowledge, experiments, and relationships; independently led practices pursue focused work in areas including applied AI and onchain systems.

This website introduces the Guild and its public work. Portal is the place to explore the community and join. The handbook provides more detailed membership and operating context. Specialist practices explain their own offerings on their own sites.

## Public website

- [Hire the DAO (homepage)](https://www.raidguild.org/): senior designers and engineers for onchain products, digital experiences, and AI workflows; services, previous work, process FAQ, and the project inquiry form
- [Join the DAO](https://www.raidguild.org/community): how the Guild works, ways to contribute, member benefits, projects and experiments, and how to start on Portal
